About

Films. Books. Music. The places they lead.

The Brooklyn Dispatch is an independent publication about films, books, music and the places they lead.

Founding Editor

Stephen Berkowitz

Why this exists

The Brooklyn Dispatch began from a simple observation. The experience of art rarely ends when the credits roll or the final page is turned. The conversations, recommendations, journeys and habits that follow are often just as interesting as the work itself.

This publication explores those afterlives.

About the editor

I'm Stephen Berkowitz, the founding editor of The Brooklyn Dispatch.

I grew up in London, England and, after living across the American Midwest, West Coast and now the East Coast, I find myself in Brooklyn, New York.

I've always been interested in the ways films, books and music shape how we experience places, conversations and everyday life. Over the years I found myself keeping notes after finishing a novel, leaving the cinema or discovering a new album. Not reviews, but observations about where they led next.

The Brooklyn Dispatch grew naturally from that habit. It is a place to collect essays, notebooks and recommendations that explore those connections.
